test_title: PYST 02: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 06 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Choose the correct indirect speech form of the following sentence.

The labourers said to the contractor, "Did you ask the manager when we are going to receive our remuneration that has been pending for the last three months?"

options.text: The labourers asked the contractor if he asked the manager when they were going to receive their remuneration that had been pending for the previous three months.
The labourers asked the contractor if he had asked the manager when they are going to receive their remuneration that was pending for the previous three months.
The labourers asked the contractor if had he asked the manager when they are going to receive their remuneration that was pending for the last three months.
The labourers asked the contractor if he had asked the manager when they were going to receive their remuneration that had been pending for the previous three months.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** The labourers asked the contractor if he had asked the manager when they were going to receive their remuneration that had been pending for the previous three months.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"Did you ask" becomes "if he had asked"**
 
 
• Direct question "Did you ask" is converted to indirect "if he had asked."
 
• Pronoun "you" is changed to "he" to match the subject of indirect speech.
 
• Verb "ask" is changed to "had asked" to reflect past perfect tense.
 
 
 
• **"when we are going to receive" becomes "when they were going to receive"**
 
 
• Pronoun "we" is converted to "they" to align with indirect speech.
 
• Verb "are going" is changed to "were going" to match past tense.
 
 
 
• **"that has been pending for the last three months" becomes "that had been pending for the previous three months"**
 
 
• Verb "has been" is changed to "had been" to reflect past perfect tense.
 
• Time reference "last three months" is changed to "previous three months" for indirect speech.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• Direct speech question is converted into a statement in indirect speech.
 
• No quotation marks are used in indirect speech.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "The labourers asked the contractor if he asked the manager when they were going to receive their remuneration that had been pending for the previous three months."

 
 
• Incorrect tense: "he asked" should be "he had asked" to reflect past perfect tense.
 
 
 
• **Option 2:** "The labourers asked the contractor if he had asked the manager when they are going to receive their remuneration that was pending for the previous three months."
 
 
• Incorrect tense: "they are going" should be "they were going" to match the past context.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** "The labourers asked the contractor if had he asked the manager when they are going to receive their remuneration that was pending for the last three months."
 
 
• Incorrect word order: "if had he asked" should be "if he had asked."
 
• Incorrect tense: "they are going" should be "they were going."
